verdict.rationale: WorkOS documents first-party MFA in AuthKit: users can be enrolled, and MFA can be enabled from the dashboard's Authentication page. Pricing also lists MFA as included in AuthKit. The evidence does not name TOTP authenticator apps, backup or recovery codes, or step-up enforcement, so only the core MFA capability is shown. Missing for 10: explicit TOTP authenticator-app support, backup/recovery codes, step-up/re-authentication enforcement for sensitive actions, details on org-level MFA requirement policies, independent or hands-on corroboration.
